records.source: Do you like rainy days as much as I do, @?
records.translation: Gusto mo rin ba ang mga maulang araw gaya ko, @?

records.source: We're different in so many ways... but that's alright.
records.translation: Napakarami nating pagkakaiba... pero ayos lang iyon.

records.source: Good morning, @. I went out early and found this for you. [305 308 203 795 397]#$e#I hope it's not too strange.
records.translation: Magandang umaga, @. Maaga akong lumabas at natagpuan ko ito para sa iyo. [305 308 203 795 397]#$e#Sana ay hindi ito masyadong kakaiba.

records.source: I wonder if the wizard knows about... this? I hope he can keep a secret.$s
records.translation: Iniisip ko kung alam ng Mago ang tungkol sa... ganito? Sana ay marunong siyang magtago ng lihim.$s

records.source: As much as I try to be civilized, I have the urge to be mischievous sometimes...$6#$e#They say it's a condition of my people.
records.translation: Gaano man ako magsikap maging sibilisado, nakakaramdam ako minsan ng pagnanasang manggulo...$6#$e#Sabi nila ay likas iyon sa mga kababayan ko.

records.source: Ah, it's more humid today with the rain... I feel a lot more comfortable.
records.translation: Ah, mas mahalumigmig ngayon dahil sa ulan... Di-hamak na mas komportable ako.

records.source: On nights like this, those who gaze out windows sometimes see shadowy figures. To think... it might've been me.$7
records.translation: Sa mga gabing tulad nito, nakakakita minsan ng mga anyong tila anino ang mga taong nakatanaw sa bintana. Isipin mo... baka ako iyon.$7

records.source: If the other shadow people knew about our living arrangement, they would... 'punish' me.$s#$e#Most of them despise humans, you know.
records.translation: Kung malaman ng iba pang Taong-Anino ang tungkol sa pagsasama natin sa bahay, “parurusahan” nila ako.$s#$e#Alam mo, kinamumuhian ng karamihan sa kanila ang mga tao.

records.source: You're sopping wet, and cold! Isn't that dangerous to your species?$s
records.translation: Basang-basa ka at nilalamig! Hindi ba mapanganib iyan para sa uri mo?$s

records.source: I already had dinner, but it wasn't something you'd be able to eat... sorry.
records.translation: Kumain na ako ng hapunan, pero hindi mo makakain ang kinain ko... pasensiya na.

records.source: Ever since I left my people, I've been searching for a new home... now I belong somewhere. That means everything to me.
records.translation: Mula nang iwan ko ang mga kababayan ko, naghahanap ako ng bagong tahanan... Ngayon ay may lugar na para sa akin. Napakahalaga niyon sa akin.

records.source: It's said that my people came here long ago, when a great catastrophe allowed spirits from the void to cross into the physical plane.
records.translation: Sinasabing dumating dito ang mga kababayan ko noong napakatagal na panahon, nang pahintulutan ng isang malaking sakuna ang mga espiritu mula sa Kawalan na tumawid sa materyal na daigdig.

records.source: The sound of the rain reminds me of the sewers... it's comforting.#$e#The sewers were my refuge... I felt safe there. But don't worry... I feel the same way about my new home, too.
records.translation: Ipinaaalala sa akin ng tunog ng ulan ang mga Imburnal... nakapagpapaginhawa iyon.#$e#Kanlungan ko ang mga Imburnal... Ligtas ang pakiramdam ko roon. Pero huwag kang mag-alala... Ganoon din ang pakiramdam ko sa bago kong tahanan.

records.source: If I could come help you, I would... but I'll do my best to keep the house in order.
records.translation: Kung makatutulong ako sa iyo, gagawin ko... pero gagawin ko ang lahat upang mapanatiling maayos ang bahay.

records.source: I tried my best to make human food... [203 204 651 225]#$e#You can eat it later, don't worry about it...
records.translation: Ginawa ko ang lahat upang maghanda ng pagkaing pantao... [203 204 651 225]#$e#Maaari mo itong kainin mamaya, huwag kang mag-alala...

records.source: I'm happy here, in the house. I like to spend all my time in a good spot... I don't need to "get out" like humans do.#$e#But I understand that you need to! Please don't feel like you have to stay here with me.$3
records.translation: Masaya ako rito sa bahay. Gusto kong gugulin ang lahat ng oras ko sa isang komportableng lugar... Hindi ko kailangang “lumabas” gaya ng mga tao.#$e#Pero nauunawaan kong kailangan mong lumabas! Huwag mong isiping kailangan mong manatili rito kasama ko.$3

records.source: I'm considering spending my day all balled up and wedged in the corner...#$e#What? You mean you don't do that?$3
records.translation: Pinag-iisipan kong gugulin ang araw na nakapulupot at nakasiksik sa sulok...#$e#Ano? Hindi mo ginagawa iyon?$3

records.source: On Fridays, I like to stay quiet out of respect for Yoba. I hope you don't mind.
records.translation: Tuwing Biyernes, gusto kong manahimik bilang paggalang kay Yoba. Sana ay ayos lang sa iyo.

records.source: I wish I could help you on the farm, but I can't go out in the sun...
records.translation: Sana ay matulungan kita sa bukid, pero hindi ako makalabas sa sikat ng araw...

records.source: I cleaned all the bugs out of the house today... Sorry, I didn't save you any! *smack*$7
records.translation: Inalis ko ang lahat ng kulisap sa bahay ngayon... Pasensiya na at wala akong itinira para sa iyo! *ngasab*$7

records.source: You feel solid... sometimes I wish I had bones, too...$s
records.translation: Buong-buo ang katawan mo... Minsan ay hinihiling kong mayroon din akong mga buto...$s

records.source: Sometimes I wonder if humans and shadow people could really ever co-exist... It's a lovely idea, but is it realistic?$s#$e#I hope so...
records.translation: Minsan ay iniisip ko kung maaari nga bang mamuhay nang magkasama ang mga tao at Mga Taong-Anino... Magandang ideya iyon, pero makatotohanan ba?$s#$e#Sana...

records.source: Sometimes I pause and think of all that I've learned about humans from you...#$b#I wish all my fellow shadow people could know this feeling.
records.translation: Minsan ay humihinto ako at iniisip ang lahat ng natutuhan ko tungkol sa mga tao mula sa iyo...#$b#Sana ay maranasan ng lahat ng kapwa ko Taong-Anino ang damdaming ito.

records.source: I want to be a good housemate for you, but I never know if I'm doing well... *groan* $s#$e#I have a hard time understanding human expression. B... but... you're happy living with me?#$e#Okay!$7
records.translation: Gusto kong maging mabuting kasama mo sa bahay, pero hindi ko alam kung maayos ang ginagawa ko... *ungol* $s#$e#Nahihirapan akong unawain ang mga ekspresyon ng tao. P... pero... masaya kang kasama ako rito?#$e#Sige!$7

records.source: Hi, @. Welcome home. You look like you've been working hard out there!$h
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Maligayang pag-uwi. Mukhang nagsikap ka nang husto roon!$h

records.source: I'll stay out here for just a bit, but we've got to be careful... if anyone approaches I'll need to hide!
records.translation: Mananatili ako rito sa labas nang kaunti, pero kailangan nating mag-ingat... Kung may lalapit, kailangan kong magtago!

records.source: It's rare that I can step outside!
records.translation: Bihira akong makalabas!

records.source: What a beautiful day!$h
records.translation: Napakagandang araw!$h

records.source: Wide open spaces make me nervous...$s
records.translation: Kinakabahan ako sa malalawak at bukas na lugar...$s

records.source: Please go about your day, I'll just stay here and guard the house.
records.translation: Ipagpatuloy mo lang ang mga gawain mo, mananatili ako rito at babantayan ang bahay.

records.source: I'll wait here for a bit, and see if any bugs come my way.#$e#I haven't had breakfast yet!
records.translation: Maghihintay ako rito sandali at titingnan kung may kulisap na lalapit sa akin.#$e#Hindi pa ako nag-aalmusal!

records.source: I'm not sure how, but Yoba has blessed this house with a 'child'...
records.translation: Hindi ko alam kung paano, pero biniyayaan ni Yoba ang bahay na ito ng isang “anak”...

records.source: Don't worry... I already made %kid1 and %kid2 a void egg omelet.
records.translation: Huwag kang mag-alala... Ipinaghanda ko na sina %kid1 at %kid2 ng tortang Itlog ng Kawalan.

records.source: I worry about the future of the children... But I trust that Yoba has a plan for them.
records.translation: Nag-aalala ako tungkol sa kinabukasan ng mga bata... Pero nagtitiwala akong may plano si Yoba para sa kanila.

records.source: This house has been blessed with two children, now... Does that mean Yoba approves of our unconventional living arrangement?
records.translation: Biniyayaan na ngayon ng dalawang anak ang bahay na ito... Nangangahulugan ba iyon na sinasang-ayunan ni Yoba ang di-karaniwang pagsasama natin sa bahay?

records.source: I feel a sensation in my body... is this... 'platonic love'?$l#$b#... Oh, wait... I'm just shedding my skin.$s
records.translation: May nararamdaman ako sa katawan ko... Ito ba ang... “platonikong pag-ibig”?$l#$b#... Ah, sandali... Nagbabalat lang pala ako.$s

records.source: I've learned to overcome my bias against humans... but Dwarves still disgust me.$a
records.translation: Natutuhan kong madaig ang pagkiling ko laban sa mga tao... pero nandidiri pa rin ako sa mga Duwende.$a

records.source: You started nibbling on me during the night, and mumbling about 'black lick or ish'... what did you mean by that?$3
records.translation: Kinakagat-kagat mo ako kagabi at bumubulong tungkol sa “itim na liko o ris”... ano ang ibig mong sabihin doon?$3

records.source: We're making progress, and I feel really hopeful.$h
records.translation: Umuunlad tayo, at talagang umaasa ako.$h

records.source: I was just admiring this lovely house... what a wonderful place.$l
records.translation: Hinahangaan ko lang ang kaibig-ibig na bahay na ito... napakagandang lugar.$l

records.source: I won't ever grow old, but you will. Sometimes it makes me sad... but that's okay.$s
records.translation: Hindi ako tatanda kailanman, pero tatanda ka. Minsan ay nalulungkot ako dahil doon... pero ayos lang.$s

records.source: Do you think your Grandpa would approve of a monster living in his house?
records.translation: Sa tingin mo ba ay papayag ang Lolo mo na may halimaw na nakatira sa bahay niya?

records.source: Do you think we could get in trouble for living together?$s
records.translation: Sa tingin mo ba ay maaari tayong magkaproblema dahil magkasama tayong nakatira?$s

records.source: It's so bright in here... I might close my eyes for a few hours.$s
records.translation: Napakaliwanag dito... Baka ipikit ko ang mga mata ko nang ilang oras.$s

records.source: I can't go outside, I can only eat certain food, I need the temperature a certain way... I hope it's not too much of a bother to live with me, @.$s
records.translation: Hindi ako makalabas, mga partikular na pagkain lang ang maaari kong kainin, at kailangan ko ng tamang temperatura... Sana ay hindi masyadong mahirap ang mamuhay kasama ko, @.$s

records.source: Welwick says I'm cursed today.$s
records.translation: Sabi ni Welwick ay isinumpa ako ngayon.$s

records.source: I'll tell you a secret... I don't actually sleep, I just lay there with my eyes closed...
records.translation: May sasabihin akong lihim... Hindi talaga ako natutulog, nakahiga lang ako roon nang nakapikit...

records.source: You're a strange one, to want to live with a creature like me.
records.translation: Kakaiba ka dahil gusto mong mamuhay kasama ang isang nilalang na tulad ko.

records.source: I'm going to clean the house all day! This is fun.$7
records.translation: Maglilinis ako ng bahay buong araw! Nakakatuwa ito.$7

records.source: I wonder if we'll live here our entire lives? Moving would probably be too dangerous for me.
records.translation: Dito kaya tayo titira habambuhay? Malamang ay masyadong mapanganib para sa akin ang lumipat.

records.source: *sigh*... Maybe I should've stayed with my own kind.$s
records.translation: *Buntong-hininga*... Baka dapat ay nanatili na lang ako kasama ng sarili kong uri.$s

records.source: ...Do you still like me?$s
records.translation: ...Gusto mo pa rin ba ako?$s

records.source: Are you still happy, living with me?$s
records.translation: Masaya ka pa rin bang kasama ako sa bahay?$s

records.source: I think you'd be happier living with another human...$s
records.translation: Sa tingin ko ay mas sasaya kang mamuhay kasama ang ibang tao...$s

records.source: I've detected a change in your behavior... what does it mean? *groan*$s
records.translation: May napansin akong pagbabago sa kilos mo... ano ang ibig sabihin nito? *ungol*$s

records.source: You only have one short life to live... are you certain you want to spend it with a hideous creature like me?$s
records.translation: Iisa lang ang maikling buhay mo... tiyak ka bang gusto mong gugulin iyon kasama ang isang kahindik-hindik na nilalang na tulad ko?$s

records.source: Maybe a relationship like this is destined to fail...$s
records.translation: Baka nakatadhanang mabigo ang isang ugnayang tulad nito...$s

records.source: You seem unhappy lately...$s
records.translation: Mukha kang malungkot nitong huli...$s

records.source: I miss the sewers.$s
records.translation: Nami-miss ko ang mga Imburnal.$s

records.source: What's your plan for the new year, @?
records.translation: Ano ang plano mo para sa bagong taon, @?

records.source: You should go to the flower dance tomorrow! Don't worry about me.
records.translation: Dapat kang pumunta sa Sayaw ng Bulaklak bukas! Huwag kang mag-alala sa akin.

records.source: I get sunburnt very easily, so I need to be careful this time of year.
records.translation: Napakadali kong masunog sa araw, kaya kailangan kong mag-ingat sa panahong ito.

records.source: Mmm... what's that lovely smell? You must've been sweating all night...$h
records.translation: Mmm... ano ang kaibig-ibig na amoy na iyan? Malamang ay buong gabi kang pinagpawisan...$h

records.source: It's summer... that means the house is full of flies.#$e#Don't worry, I'll take care of them. It's good protein!$h
records.translation: Tag-init na... ibig sabihin, punô ng langaw ang bahay.#$e#Huwag kang mag-alala, ako na ang bahala sa mga iyon. Magandang mapagkukunan ng protina ang mga iyon!$h

records.source: I don't feel like doing anything today.
records.translation: Wala akong ganang gumawa ng anuman ngayon.

records.source: Have you figured out what you're going to use for your grange display tomorrow?
records.translation: Nakapagpasya ka na ba kung ano ang gagamitin mo sa eksibit mo sa Perya bukas?

records.source: If I showed up to the Spirit's Eve festival they'd put me in a cage...$s
records.translation: Kung magpapakita ako sa pista ng Bisperas ng mga Espiritu, ikukulong nila ako...$s

records.source: Thanks for letting me stay here, @. I'm looking forward to another great year!$h
records.translation: Salamat sa pagpapatira sa akin dito, @. Inaasam ko ang isa na namang magandang taon!$h

records.source: #$c .5#We're so physically different that it's a challenge to live together, isn't it?#$e#I hope the humidity here isn't bothersome to you. We both have to compromise in order to live together!
records.translation: #$c .5#Napakalaki ng pagkakaiba ng mga katawan natin kaya mahirap mamuhay nang magkasama, hindi ba?#$e#Sana ay hindi ka naaabala sa halumigmig dito. Kailangan nating kapwa gumawa ng kompromiso upang mamuhay nang magkasama!

records.source: It's 'spring' now, isn't it? I can smell the peppery aroma of wild horseradish.
records.translation: “Tagsibol” na ngayon, hindi ba? Naaamoy ko ang maanghang na halimuyak ng Ligaw na Horseradish.

records.source: You call this time of year 'summer', right? The warmth and humidity is nice, but I wish it wasn't so sunny.
records.translation: “Tag-init” ang tawag mo sa panahong ito, tama? Masarap ang init at halumigmig, pero sana ay hindi gaanong maaraw.

records.source: It's been feeling a bit cooler lately, with a musty smell. You call this time of year 'fall', correct?
records.translation: Medyo mas malamig nitong huli at may amoy-kulob. “Taglagas” ang tawag mo sa panahong ito, tama?

records.source: The darkness this time of year is very soothing. If only it were warmer!
records.translation: Lubhang nakapagpapakalma ang dilim sa panahong ito ng taon. Kung mas mainit lang sana!
